lines.t: All paths lead to this throne, that's the code in the bone
Every breath, every step, every tear gets known
From the crib to the grave, to the gray white seat
Every knee gonna drop, every heart gon' beat
All pain, all streets, all souls get shown Every road, every wound, every scar gets known
From the gutter to the gates, from the dark to the gold Every story, every secret, every heart gets told
All fear, all sin, all pride gets blown Every path that we walk ends up at his throne
Girl raised where the cul-de-sac glows Big house, cold house, my wine still flows
On a roll, smile with a storm inside Scrolling through the grams just to feel alive
Mean girl, whispers cut deep like knives Too much, not enough, start to scrip a lie
Make her mask on, but the hurt still bleeds Late 90M's for a hitter, please
You grew song while she breaks at home Knows all the words, but she feels alone
Try pills, try blades in the bathroom stall Stared at her wrist, felt nothing at all
But the hands she can't see, never left that place
When she stood on the bridge, when the tears hit her face
Stopped out, jumping just to end that ache Felt a pull on her heart, she could not shake
On the shower floor, water ice cold She cried, if you're real, I'm losing my soul
No quiet, no band, just a quiet tone Like, daughter, I see you, you're never alone
She wept till the sun started pushing through blinds
For the weight liftoff, she could not define
Same girl, same scars, but a new backbone
Every step from that night, walk toward his throne
All pain, all streets, all souls get shown
Every road, every wound, every scar gets known
From the gutter to the gates, from the dark to the gold
Every story, every secret, every heart gets told
Man on the west side, sirens at night
Pop locked up, mama working for life
First born son with a rent in his bag, baby bro need shoes
Fool run the slack, learn math on the block with a scaling pad
Straight A mine and the world off track
Funeral rules, we get black suits, one thing
Every closed casket could've been in
One shootout, bullets tore up the street
One pass close, felt five eyes cheat
Back at the window in the demo room
He said, if this it, I'ma die too soon
He thought of grandma in that old church pew
Songs about a king making all things new
Dropped to his knees where it's broke, not clean
Take this life, I'm tighter to see
No lightning flashed as the peace rolled in
Like someone bigger stepped into his sin
Got up slow, let the block light go
Told his crew I'm out, took every blow
Now he walks those streets with a different tone
Telling young ones there they more than they shown
From the sales, from the hate, from the years unknown
Every crooked hard step got stood to his throne
All pain, all streets, all souls get shown Every road, every wound, every scar gets known
From the gutter to the gates, from the dark to the gold Every story, every secret, every heart gets told
Hands rubbed, skin cracked, there's a night run Left home broke, chasing work and sun
Coyote shout, water like sweet Two days walking, no water, no sleep
Made it through fences with dust in his lungs Fake name written, no papers, just hung
Found work high up on a steel frame site Concrete rebar, sweat and height
Form and bark like he left a man He just bows low, does all he can
Sense on pay with his callous punks
Missing his kids while he hums old songs
One new steel beam snapped from the crane
No crew froze in a rush of pain
Beam dropped fast and a chain caught tight
He later shaking knowing he been spared twice
That night in the trailer with the barebow glow
You open up a book, you have to know
Read about a kingdom with an open door
With a pole and a stranger ain't tossed no more
Tears hit pages, dust turn to mud
Heart hurt, mercy in the printed blood
Said if you'll have me, I'll be yours alone
And this long weary road bent up to the throne
All pain, all streets, all souls get shown
Every road, every wound, every scar gets known
From the suburbs, huh, to the siren's tone From the borderline dust to the marble stone
All tribes, all tongues, all flesh, one zone Every path that we walk ends up at his throne
Three lives, three lanes, same fire, same tone Same judge and the light, same love on the throne
When the beat cuts off and you stand alone You'll see every step was a path to his soul
Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh.
